themes.title: Right-wing leaders rally behind restrictive birthright citizenship policies
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing governments and parties across the U.S., Hungary, Italy, and the UK have intensified efforts to restrict birthright citizenship, often framing it as a measure against 'birth tourism' and illegal immigration. This theme reflects a coordinated push to redefine citizenship laws, with executive actions and legislative proposals gaining traction despite legal challenges.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Signed executive orders targeting birthright citizenship and 'birth tourism,' defying Supreme Court rulings.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Government rhetoric aligns with policies promoting traditional family structures and fertility incentives, indirectly supporting citizenship restrictions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government has debated immigration reforms, including citizenship restrictions, as part of broader nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's party advocates for stricter immigration controls, including revisiting birthright citizenship policies.

themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Spain, Italy, Poland, and France are leveraging recent migration crises, particularly in Ceuta and Melilla, to amplify anti-immigrant rhetoric and demand stricter border controls. This theme highlights the transnational exploitation of migration as a political tool, with parties coordinating messaging to pressure governments and shape public opinion.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands military deployment in Ceuta and Melilla, frames migration as a 'hybrid war' tactic by Morocco.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports Spain's hardline stance on migration, aligns with Vox's rhetoric on border security.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Proposes deporting Ukrainian men of conscription age, linking migration to national security threats.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes EU migration policies, advocates for stricter border controls and national sovereignty.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing administrations in the U.S., Argentina, Hungary, and the UK are pushing for cuts to social programs, including healthcare, education, and welfare, under the guise of fiscal responsibility. This theme reflects a broader trend of austerity measures and deregulation, often justified as necessary for economic recovery or national security.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes overhauling Head Start program, cutting federal regulations and funding for social services.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Advances privatization and deregulation, including cuts to healthcare and education subsidies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Implements austerity measures, including VAT cuts and energy subsidies, amid fiscal pressures.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for reducing welfare spending and cracking down on 'illegal' social benefits.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is dominating political discourse ahead of regional elections in Saxony-Anhalt and other eastern states. This theme captures the AfD's rising influence, its impact on mainstream parties, and the broader implications for German and European politics, including debates over coalition-building and democratic resilience.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt, challenges CDU/CSU and SPD, advocates for stricter immigration and anti-EU policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Monitors AfD's strategies, aligns on anti-immigration and nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Shares AfD's Eurosceptic and nationalist agenda, influences European far-right dynamics.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Observes AfD's rise, debates potential alliances and policy shifts in response to far-right gains.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Poland, Italy, Argentina, and the UK are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factionalism. This theme highlights the struggles of established leaders to maintain unity, the emergence of rival factions, and the broader implications for party cohesion and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage faces scrutiny over financial controversies, leadership challenges within the party.
